question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1
solution: The correct answer is "if." [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**** __ • The given sentence is zero conditional. • We use the zero conditional to talk about things that are generally true, especially for laws and rules. • **Example**: *If I drink too much coffee, I can't sleep at night.* • In this context, **"if"** sets up the condition or circumstance under which the advice or statement is applicable. • So, the correct answer is Option 4. • Correct paragraph:** It is often said that **if**__ you want a pet to look up to you, get a dog. If you want a pet that looks straight ______ (2) ______ you, get a horse. For an animal that looks down ______ (3) ______ you, the cat must surely ______ (4) _______ this description. Cats are their own bosses. They have little or no regard for anyone or anything. If you have ______ (5) ________ looked closely at the cat, you will observe that it looks at you from the corner of its eyes, almost condescendingly. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Whenever: **The word **"whenever"** is used to indicate any time or every time that a particular situation occurs. (जब कभी भी) • **Whether: **The word **"whether"** is typically used to introduce a choice between two or more alternatives or to express doubt or uncertainty. (चाहे) • **Ever: "Ever"** means at any time. It is used in questions and negative statements. (कभी) 1f6:T13d7,
